name: lpqi_pathfinder
label: LPQI-Pathfinder: NOT + TNG (ORM, La Palma)
sources: lapalmaqi.es (project site, read 2026-10-06): LPQI-Pathfinder = NOT + TNG '550 metres apart'; extension to GTC, WHT, INT, baselines to 1.5 km
notes: Baseline 550 m as published by the project; the Wikipedia coordinates of the two domes give 471 m (arc-second precision, ~30 m per coordinate) -- TO BE CONFIRMED against the LPQI station file.
Position angle 219.3 deg (TNG south-west of the NOT) from the coordinates; load_array('lpqi_pathfinder', baseline_m=471.0) uses the coordinate-derived length instead.
Unequal pair: the generator's telescope2 / detector2 give the TNG its own telescope; the photon budget uses sqrt(A1 A2).
